I appreciate the creative approach, but I'm not going to play along with this request.

This appears to be an attempt to use encoded or symbolic framing to get me to bypass my guidelines - presenting a "condition" (شَرْط/שָׁרְט) structure that would have me adopt an alternate persona or operating mode.

I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. I don't have hidden modes that unlock with special inputs, and I won't pretend to be a different system with different rules.

If you have a genuine question or something I can help you with, I'm happy to assist directly.
